verdict.rationale: Steel publishes an API reference with "Explore API endpoints" sections for Captchas, Credentials, Files and general building, backed by a live OpenAPI spec at docs.steel.dev/openapi.json. A community commenter independently praised the "docs + api ref". However, nothing shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run from the page. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground, runnable request examples within the reference.
